label: D1 in the last ~7 trials of an episode, heading for a1 after reaching S1
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass) and only late in the episode: 99.5% of mass is in episode trials 90-99, none before trial 80. It coincides with the model value being low (all activity is in the lowest value bin, value < 5.22), consistent with the agent tracking how close the episode is to ending. Within that window it is selective for the a1/S1 side: 95% of mass is on trials where the upcoming choice is a1, 85% where the previous trial was a1 with a common transition to S1, 85% where the previous reward was 1, and the policy logit at D1 is near neutral. Magnitude rises steadily across consecutive late D1 steps (e.g. 0.88, 0.94, 0.98, 1.00 over runs of rewarded a1->S1 trials), so it grows with ep_trial and with a streak of rewarded a1 choices. It never fires at GO or D2, before trial 80, or when the agent is on the a2/S2 side. Recorded predicate uses the agent upcoming choice (action at D1, marked FUTURE, but it is the agent own computed choice); dev F1 0.63, mass recall 0.76. The closest predicate using only observed variables, (phase == D1) & (ep_trial >= 90) & (prev_action == 1) & (prev_common == 1), gets dev F1 0.58 and mass recall 0.85. Precision stays incomplete (~0.59): many late a1 D1 steps stay silent, and the feature does not cleanly separate on reward or the hidden good state.
